# Armor does not mitigate Damage over Time

- **Status:** ✅ Confirmed
- **Skills affected:** Mind Control, Path of Flames
- **Mechanic tags:** dot, mitigation
- **Last verified:** 2026-07-10 by Tyra

## Setup

SS12. Skill level 16, no gear. Mind Control (Erosion, base 222/sec) and Path of Flames (Fire, base 299/sec) vs the standard Level-85 dummy (30% erosion resistance, 30% elemental resistance, 50% armor) — see [training-dummy](training-dummy.md).

## Raw data points

Mind Control base 222/sec → ~155/sec vs the dummy (`222 × 0.70 = 155.4`, resistance-only). Had armor also applied, the multiplier would have been ×0.49 (per [training-dummy](training-dummy.md)'s non-physical hit mitigation), giving ~109/sec — not observed. Path of Flames: base 299/sec → ~209/sec (`299 × 0.70 = 209.3`, resistance-only); the armor-inclusive prediction would have been ~146.5/sec — not observed.

## Derived / confirmed formula

DoT taken = base × (1 − resistance). No armor term, unlike a Hit (`(1 − resistance) × (1 − armor_fraction)`).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Corroborates the Help DB's explicit statement rather than discovering something new — this in-game measurement is confirmation, not the primary source.

## Implementation (engine model)

**Engine consequence:** `armor_pen` is inert against DoT — `Stat.ARMOR_PEN`'s `affects` tuple in `backend/models/stat_meta.py` (~L133) has already had `"dot"` removed (was `_ALL_DMGF`, now excludes DoT; see the MISLABEL-fix comment at ~L131). Same fix applied to `Stat.MINION_ARMOR_PEN` (~L610). A DoT damage stage must use a resistance-only target multiplier, never `offense.py::_target_mitigation` (which multiplies in `(1 − eff_armor)`) — see the sibling `_target_mitigation_dot` noted in the `DamageRow` docstring at `offense.py` ~L709-731.
